title: Larkspur Mutual Member Tenure Credit on HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Structure Supplementals
content:
**To our HomeGuard Homeowners Policy members: the member-tenure credit.**

As a policyholder-owned mutual, Larkspur recognises long membership when it settles the other-structures supplemental on a HomeGuard claim. A member-tenure credit is added in dollars to the supplemental payment. It depends on two counts:

- **Tenure**: whole months from the policy's original effective date to the day of the call.
- **Recent claims**: the claims on the policy whose date of loss falls in the 36 months before the call. The claim being settled is one of them when its own date of loss falls in that window.

## Terms of the credit

| Whole months since the original effective date | Claims with a date of loss in the 36 months before the call | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 180 or more | No more than 2 | 250.00 |
| 60 to 179 | No more than 2 | 100.00 |
| 180 or more, or 60 to 179 | 3 or more | Nothing |
| Fewer than 60 | Any | Nothing |

Both conditions of a row must hold. The credit is added to the supplemental payment before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once.

## Examples (hypothetical dates and counts)

- Original effective date 1 March 2009, call on 15 April 2024: 181 whole months. Two claims with a date of loss in the 36 months before the call: credit 250.00.
- The same member with three such claims: no credit, despite the long tenure.
- Original effective date 1 May 2019, call on 30 April 2024: 59 whole months, one month short of 60: no credit. A call on 1 May 2024 reaches 60 whole months: credit 100.00 with no more than 2 recent claims.
- Exactly 180 whole months with 2 recent claims: credit 250.00. At 179 whole months: credit 100.00.
